claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_feature_area
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The unit's entire mechanic is expanding the area of an existing named class feature (Aura of Protection) from 10 ft to 30 ft. No current EffectAtom can reference another feature by ID and replace its area descriptor. The modify_* atoms in the surface cover AC, rolls, speed, HP max, save DC, crit range, damage, ability scores, and PB — none express 'change the emanation radius of feature X'.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Your Aura of Protection is now a 30-foot Emanation.
